QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] SCRS and PSTL 2
QuestInfo.0: The SCRS wants something. Find out what it is.
QuestInfo.1: The SCRS condemns female students who discriminate against male students because they are attracted to the Pale Student Teacher. Speak to the female students and see how they feel about this.
QuestInfo.2: The PSTL have a response to the SCRS's condemnation. This is getting confusing.
